title: Rain and Snow: From Gauge to Basin
description: From a rain gauge to a basin average: build the arithmetic, Thiessen and inverse-distance estimates on a synthetic storm field you can inspect completely, then use real CAMELS-US Daymet precipitation for four basins to see how hard, how often and when it falls, test a rain-snow temperature threshold, and reproduce two CAMELS climate attributes with a live Python cell.

citation.text: Newman, A. J. et al. (2015). Development of a large-sample watershed-scale hydrometeorological data set for the contiguous USA. Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 19, 209-223.

author: Mohammad Galib, Purdue University
